body.x: HANCOM participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced an artificial intelligence ‘MDS robot’.

Based on office software, HANCOM is introducing various software to improve the productivity of its customers worldwide. With office solutions that break the boundaries between devices such as PC and mobile, it is making a success story of our language office against foreign solution monopoly. In addition, based on solid financial structure, HANCOM has been making steep sales growth rate every year, satisfying shareholders, customers and employees by fulfilling responsibility management. At CES this year, HANCOM introduced an artificial intelligence ‘MDS robot’ as well as interpretation and translation solution, SanCheong(team communication monitoring solution). With MDS robot as a main product, there are logistics robots, helicopter robots, and air clean robots. MDS stands for Make Different & Smart and provides one-stop service.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
